record.original_question: Determine the automorphism groups of Goppa codes, since the chapter states that these groups were not known in general.

evidence.quote: The automorphism groups of Goppa codes are not known.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let q be a prime power, and let L = (α_1, …, α_n) be a tuple of pairwise distinct elements of an extension field F_{q^m}, and let g(x) ∈ F_{q^m}[x] be a polynomial (the Goppa polynomial) such that g(α_i) ≠ 0 for all i. The classical Goppa code Γ(L, g) is the F_q-linear code

  Γ(L, g) = { (c_1, …, c_n) ∈ F_q^n : ∑_{i=1}^{n} c_i / (x − α_i) ≡ 0 (mod g(x)) }.

The (permutation) automorphism group Aut(Γ(L, g)) is the group of permutations σ ∈ S_n such that (c_{σ(1)}, …, c_{σ(n)}) ∈ Γ(L, g) for every codeword (c_1, …, c_n) ∈ Γ(L, g); more generally, one may consider the monomial or semilinear automorphism group.

Problem: Give an explicit description of the automorphism group Aut(Γ(L, g)) for arbitrary classical Goppa codes Γ(L, g), in terms of the data L and g.
artifact.status_search_result: The automorphism groups of Goppa codes have been determined in several special cases (e.g., classical Goppa codes associated with the Hermitian and Deligne–Lusztig curves; codes with non-trivial dihedral or alternating automorphism groups have been constructed). Sufficient conditions are known under which the automorphism group of a geometric Goppa code coincides with that of the underlying curve. However, a general explicit description of Aut(Γ(L,g)) for arbitrary classical Goppa codes does not appear in the literature, so the problem remains only partially solved.

status_evidence.title: On the Automorphism Group of Various Goppa Codes
status_evidence.snippet: Determines the automorphism group of various Goppa codes associated with certain function fields of genus g>0; automorphism group of the function field embeds into that of the code, and under conditions on D and G the two groups are isomorphic.
status_evidence.claim: Automorphism groups have been computed in special cases (Hermitian, Deligne–Lusztig).

status_evidence.title: On automorphism groups of certain Goppa codes
status_evidence.snippet: Sufficient conditions ensuring that all automorphisms of a Goppa code come from automorphisms of the curve.
status_evidence.claim: Partial results identifying the automorphism group with that of the curve.

status_evidence.title: Non-binary expurgated and extended Goppa codes with dihedral or 4-th alternating automorphism groups
status_evidence.snippet: Recent constructions producing Goppa codes with prescribed dihedral or alternating automorphism groups.
status_evidence.claim: Active recent research suggests no full general answer.
